image_description: A blue and silver two-tone minibus viewed from the rear three-quarter angle. The vehicle features a boxy shape, a row of side windows, a rear window with wipers, vertical taillights, and a visible license plate area. It appears to be parked on an asphalt surface.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Boxy body shape noticeably shorter than a full-size bus, yet tall enough for passengers to stand or sit upright comfortably.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle exhibits the characteristic high-roof, boxy silhouette of a minibus, distinct from a sedan or SUV, and proportional to the 'shorter than full-size bus' description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Multiple side windows are clearly visible along the flank, and the front cabin structure implies a large windshield consistent with this vehicle class.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The roofline is significantly higher than standard cars. A door seam/handle is visible on the side near the front wheel arch, indicating a front/mid-body entrance.
The vertical seam and handle placement on the side correspond to a sliding door mechanism typical for this vehicle type.
The image is taken from the rear; the front hood/engine bay is not visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rear flat or slightly angled panel with taillights and license plate mount.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rear view clearly shows a flat vertical panel, distinct vertical taillight clusters, and a recessed area containing a license plate.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: White, yellow, or company livery paint with route markings.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle has a two-tone blue and silver/white paint scheme, which fits the 'company livery' description, although specific route text is not legible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Standard van-sized wheels with steel or alloy rims.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible rear wheel matches the size and style (steel rim with hubcap) expected for a commercial van/minibus.
The length and window configuration suggest a capacity within the 4-10 passenger range, distinguishing it from larger city buses.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The characters on the license plate are illegible and structurally nonsensical (melting into each other), a common AI artifact. The badge text on the right side of the rear door is also blurred and unreadable.
The side mirror housing lacks sharp definition and seems to blend slightly into the window frame. The door handle is vague and lacks mechanical precision.
The geometry of the rear bumper corner is slightly soft and doesn't align perfectly with the rigid lines of the body panel above it, suggesting minor geometric inconsistency.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the vehicle is correctly classified as a minibus and not a standard van or full-size bus based on visual features.
To verify the structural rigidity of the boxy shape and ensure the wheels are properly grounded without floating or melting into the pavement.
To check for boundary bleeding between the glass/windows and the metal body, and to ensure the door seams are topologically continuous.
To rigorously analyze the illegible text artifacts noted in the license plate and rear branding.

focus_areas: Structural integrity of the boxy chassis
Legibility and structure of the license plate text
Connection points of wheels to the ground
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the license plate; AI often generates gibberish here. Verify if the 'minibus' classification holds up against similar van classes. Check if the side mirror is physically attached or floating.
